#################################################################################################### 
Purpose of script: To check the convergence and WAIC of the models

####################################################################################################

# Set up

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("../00_dirs.R")

theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Define main analyses

```{r}
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuwpt", "ipv1",
             "hib", "menc", "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")
```

# Read in data

```{r}
# Obtain best models according to waic 
waic_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/modres/all_waicbest.rds"))
waiccomb_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waiccombbest.rds"))
waic_best_all <- bind_rows(waiccomb_best, waic_best)

waic_best_all %>% ungroup() %>% distinct(pat) %>% arrange(pat)

# Obtain gaps and inclusion/exclusion for gaps from simulations
all_datagaps <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_datagaps.rds"))
all_datagapssim <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_datagapssim.rds"))

# Obtain the mod to var 
tidy_modtovar <- readRDS(paste0(dirs$modres, "/tidy_modtovar.rds"))

# Threshold interpretation
threshold_ref <- read_excel(paste0(dirs$raw, "/thresholds_immvacc.xlsx"))
threshold_ref
```

# Obtain model information

```{r}
dat_mod <- waic_best_all %>%
  filter(dat != "sebirth_s08", mod_name_best != "base", str_detect(mod_best, "multi|opv", negate = TRUE),
         dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08")) %>%
  left_join(tidy_modtovar %>% rename(mod_best = mod), by = join_by(pat, mod_out, dat, mod_best)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Prepare fixed covariates and thresholds

```{r}
# Obtain median for quantitative variables and unique values for qualitative variables 
dat_fixed <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(dat_mod)), function(x) {
  pomp::bake(paste0(dirs$modres, "/modres_ve/fixed_", dat_mod$mod_best[x]), dir = "", {
    df <- readRDS(paste0("/Volumes/ExternalSSD_LABG_Work/_seas_imm_backup/outputs/models/",
                         dat_mod$pat[x], "/", dat_mod$mod_best[x]))$data
    df %>%
      summarise(
        across(any_of(c("age", "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3", "time_vl_s1", "vac_conc")), 
               \(x) min(x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_min"),
        across(any_of(c("age", "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3", "time_vl_s1", "vac_conc")), 
               \(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_max"),
        across(any_of(c("age", "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3", "time_vl_s1", "vac_conc")), 
               \(x) quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_q75"),
        across(any_of(c("age", "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3", "time_vl_s1", "vac_conc")), 
               \(x) quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_q25"),
        across(any_of(c("age", "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3", "time_vl_s1", "vac_conc")), 
               \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
        across(any_of(c("vac_name_v1", "sex", "doses")), \(x) list(unique(na.omit(x))))) %>%
      mutate(mod_best = dat_mod$mod_best[x], pat = dat_mod$pat[x])
  })
})

dat_fixed %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  select(mod_best, starts_with("age"))

# Obtain methods and cutoffs for each model 
dat_cutoff <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(dat_mod)), function(x) {
  readRDS(glue("{dirs$modfit}/data", str_remove_all(dat_mod$dat[x], "_|s08"), "_brms_", 
               dat_mod$pat[x], "_v", dat_mod$vac[x], "_s08.rds")) %>%
    distinct(imm_met_s1, imm_sero_s1, threshold_assay = imm_cutoff_s1) %>%
    mutate(mod_best = dat_mod$mod_best[x], pat = dat_mod$pat[x])}) %>%
  left_join(threshold_ref, by = join_by(imm_met_s1, pat)) 

# Combine fixed values and thresholds   
dat_cov <- distinct(dat_fixed) %>% 
  mutate(
    age_fixed = if_else(age < 12, 8, 52),
    time_v1_v2_fixed = if_else(time_v1_v2 < 40, 30, 30),
    time_v2_v3_fixed = if_else(time_v2_v3 < 40, 30, 30),
    time_vl_s1_fixed = 30,
    time_v2_v3_fixed = if_else(pat == "rota", 60, time_v2_v3_fixed)) %>%
  left_join(distinct(dat_cutoff), by = join_by(mod_best, pat)) %>% 
  select(pat, mod_best, everything())
```

# With CIs per draws 

```{r}
source("../fun_mod/fun_venewdata.R")
# For each dat_cov
prob_threshold_l <- purrr::map(1:nrow(dat_cov), function(x) {
  pomp::bake(paste0(dirs$modres, "/modres_ve/vediff_", dat_cov$mod_best[x]), dir = "", {
  message(glue("Estimating probability above threshold: {dat_cov$mod_best[x]}"))
  
    # Gather the data 
    datmod_x <- filter(dat_mod, mod_best == dat_cov[x, "mod_best"]) %>% slice(1)
    mod <- readRDS(file.path("/Volumes/ExternalSSD_LABG_Work/_seas_imm_backup/outputs/models",
                             datmod_x$pat[1], datmod_x$mod_best[1]))
    dat <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modfit}/data", str_remove_all(datmod_x$dat[1], "_|s08"), "_brms_", 
                        datmod_x$pat[1], "_v", datmod_x$vac[1], "_s08.rds")) 
    datcov_x <- dat_cov[x, ]
    
    # Create new data 
    clu_name <- str_remove_all(datmod_x$mod_name_best[1], "csi_")
    newdat <- fun_venewdat(dat, datcov_x, clu_name)
  
    # Obtain probability above from Gamma distribution 
    mu <- posterior_epred(mod, newdata = newdat, re_formula = NA)
    shape <- as_draws_df(mod)$shape[seq_len(nrow(mu))]
    prob_mat <- pgamma(q = datcov_x$threshold_protect[[1]], shape = shape, rate = shape / mu,
                       lower.tail = FALSE) %>% t()
    
    ## Summarise means -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    prob_ci <- matrixStats::rowQuantiles(prob_mat, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
    prob_draws <- newdat %>%
      bind_cols(tibble(
        prob_mean = matrixStats::rowMeans2(prob_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
        prob_med  = prob_ci[, 2],
        prob_cilo = prob_ci[, 1],
    
            prob_ciup = prob_ci[, 3]))
    # Add clu variable
    if (clu_name != "cs") prob_draws <- rename(prob_draws, clu = all_of(clu_name))
    if (!"clu" %in% names(prob_draws)) prob_draws <- mutate(prob_draws, clu = NA_character_)
    
    prob_threshold_x <- prob_draws %>%
      mutate(clu = str_replace_all(clu, " ", ""),
             mod_best = datmod_x$mod_best[1]) %>%
      left_join(distinct(all_datagaps, mod_best = mod, vac_week_v1, clu, tot),
                by = join_by(vac_week_v1, clu, mod_best)) %>%
      left_join(select(datcov_x, mod_best, pat, imm_met_s1, imm_sero_s1, threshold_assay, threshold_protect, 
                       threshold_status, threshold_evidence), by = join_by(mod_best)) %>%
      left_join(select(datmod_x, -c(patcomb, patcomb_tidy)), by = join_by(mod_best, pat)) %>%
      relocate(pat, pat_tidy, mod_best, clu, vac_week_v1, sex, age, imm_met_s1, imm_sero_s1, 
               threshold_assay, threshold_protect, threshold_status, threshold_evidence, tot)
    
    ## Summarise diff ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Identify rows included in pla
    row_info <- mutate(newdat, .row_id = row_number())

    # Add clu variable
    if (clu_name != "cs") row_info <- rename(row_info, clu = all_of(clu_name))
    if (!"clu" %in% names(row_info)) row_info <- mutate(row_info, clu = NA_character_)
    row_info <- mutate(row_info, clu = str_replace_all(clu, " ", "")) 
    
    # Define grouping variables
    group_vars <- intersect(
      names(row_info), unique(c("clu", "age", "sex", "vac_conc", names(dat_cov)[map_lgl(dat_cov, is.list)])))
    
    row_groups <- row_info %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
      summarise(row_id = list(.row_id), .groups = "drop")
    
    ## Calculate mean and range within each posterior draw
    dat_sum_x <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(row_groups)), function(i) {
        row_id_x <- row_groups$row_id[[i]]
        prob_mat_x <- prob_mat[row_id_x, ,drop = FALSE]

        sum_mean_draw <- colMeans(prob_mat_x, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
        sum_diff_draw <- (matrixStats::colMaxs(prob_mat_x, na.rm = TRUE) -
                            matrixStats::colMins(prob_mat_x, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100
        row_groups[i, ] %>%
          select(-row_id) %>%
          mutate(
            pat = datmod_x$pat[1],
            pat_tidy = datmod_x$pat_tidy[1],
            mod_best = datmod_x$mod_best[1],
            imm_met_s1 = datcov_x$imm_met_s1[[1]],
            sum_mean = median(sum_mean_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum_mean_cilo = quantile(sum_mean_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum_mean_ciup = quantile(sum_mean_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum_diff = median(sum_diff_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum_diff_cilo = quantile(sum_diff_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum_diff_ciup = quantile(sum_diff_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
          relocate(pat, pat_tidy, mod_best, clu, imm_met_s1)
        })

    list(prob_threshold = prob_threshold_x, dat_sum = dat_sum_x)
  })
})

prob_threshold <- map_df(prob_threshold_l, \(dat) dat$prob_threshold) %>%
  relocate(
    pat, pat_tidy, mod_best, clu, vac_week_v1, sex, age,
    imm_met_s1, imm_sero_s1, threshold_assay, threshold_protect,
    threshold_status, threshold_evidence, tot)
```


# Plot it
```{r}
datpl_phisumm <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/wbest_phisumm.rds"))

dat_pl <- prob_threshold %>%
  left_join(distinct(all_datagapssim, mod_best = mod, clu, included)) %>%
  filter(included == TRUE) %>%
  filter(sex == "M") %>%
  filter(!(pat == "dipht" & vac_name_v1 == "dtpa")) %>%
  filter(!(pat == "rota" & doses == "3")) %>%
  filter(!(str_detect(pat, "strep") & imm_met_s1 != "elisa")) %>%
  filter(!(str_detect(pat, "strep") & vac_name_v1 != "strep10")) %>%
  filter(!(str_detect(pat, "strep04") & mod_best != "bmv3_s08_strep04_csi_reg_6.rds")) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_clu) %>%
  mutate(age_f = factor(as.character(age), levels = c("4","6", "7","8","38","45","52"))) %>%
  mutate(threshold_status = if_else(threshold_status == "accepted", "seroprotection", threshold_status)) %>%
  mutate(threshold_status = if_else(pat == "rota", "seroprotection", threshold_status)) %>%
  filter(threshold_status == "seroprotection") %>%
  left_join(datpl_phisumm %>% rename(mod_best = mod)) %>%
  filter(pat %in% pat_sel)

plb <- dat_pl %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = prob_med*100, color = age_f, linetype = age_f,
             fill = age_f, group = age_f)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = prob_cilo*100, ymax = prob_ciup*100), alpha = 0.1, color = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_nested_wrap(~clu_tidy+reorder(paste0(pat_tidy, " (", toupper(imm_met_s1), ")"), phi_mean_shift), scales = "free_y", nest_line = TRUE,
                           solo_line = TRUE, ncol = 6) +
  geom_point(data = dat_pl %>%
               filter(!is.na(tot)), aes(y = -Inf), group = 1, color = "black", fill = "black", shape = "|", size = 3) + 
  scale_color_manual("Age at first vaccination \n(weeks)", values = c("#7AD151FF", "#2A788EFF", "#440154FF", "#7AD151FF", "#2A788EFF", "#440154FF")) + 
  scale_fill_manual("Age at first vaccination \n(weeks)", values = c("#7AD151FF", "#2A788EFF", "#440154FF", "#7AD151FF", "#2A788EFF", "#440154FF")) + 
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Age at first vaccination \n(weeks)", values = rep(c("solid", "dashed"), each = 3)) +
  scale_x_continuous("Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52), expand = c(0,0)) + 
  scale_y_continuous("Seroprotection") + 
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.byrow = TRUE, legend.title = element_text(hjust = 1))
```

dat_sum <-  map_df(prob_threshold_l, \(dat) dat$dat_sum) %>%
  left_join(distinct(all_datagapssim, mod_best = mod, clu, included)) %>%
  filter(included == TRUE) %>%
  filter(sex == "M") %>%
  filter(!(pat == "dipht" & vac_name_v1 == "dtpa")) %>%
  #filter(!(pat == "rota" & doses == "3")) %>%
  filter(!(str_detect(pat, "strep") & imm_met_s1 != "elisa")) %>%
  filter(!(str_detect(pat, "strep") & vac_name_v1 != "strep10")) %>%
  filter(!(str_detect(pat, "strep04") & mod_best != "bmv3_s08_strep04_csi_reg_6.rds")) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_clu) %>%
  mutate(age_f = factor(as.character(age), levels = c("4","6", "7","8","38","45","52"))) %>%
  left_join(distinct(prob_threshold, mod_best, threshold_status, pat, )) %>%
  mutate(threshold_status = if_else(threshold_status == "accepted", "seroprotection", threshold_status)) %>%
  mutate(threshold_status = if_else(pat == "rota", "seroprotection", threshold_status)) %>%
  filter(threshold_status == "seroprotection") %>%
  left_join(datpl_phisumm %>% rename(mod_best = mod)) %>%
  filter(pat %in% pat_sel)

pl_sum <- ggplot(dat_sum%>%
      filter(age_f %in% c(8, 52)) , aes(x = sum_mean, y = sum_diff)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = sum_mean_cilo, xmax = sum_mean_ciup, color = reorder(pat_tidy, sum_mean)), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = sum_diff_cilo, ymax = sum_diff_ciup, color = reorder(pat_tidy, sum_mean)), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(color = reorder(pat_tidy, sum_mean))) + 
  scale_color_viridis_d("") + 
  scale_x_continuous("Mean seroprotection (%)") + 
  scale_y_continuous("Seasonal variation in seroprotection (%)") + 
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.byrow = TRUE, legend.title = element_text(hjust = 1))

saveRDS(pl_sum, file = "../_figures/temp_figve.rds")
